notes: Phase 3: Title Opacity Controls — implemented fontOpacity and bgOpacity fields in TitleStyle model, clamped setters in TitleManager (Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value))), save/restore globalAlpha pattern in TitleRenderer for both background rect and text rendering, handler wiring through createTitleHandlers and createCollageMethods, two range sliders in index.html Title section with ARIA attributes (aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax). All 1920+ existing tests pass with 0 regressions. 21 new tests added: 9 TitleRenderer opacity tests (globalAlpha save/restore, no alpha leakage, edge cases) and 12 TitleManager/model tests (setter clamping, notify callbacks, createTitleStyle defaults). World-review addressed: confirmed slider range (min=0, max=1, step=0.01 = 100 steps, not 10000), added ARIA attributes for accessibility, verified rAF debouncing in CanvasRenderer prevents render stuttering.
